newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Four killed in Colombian air crash.
newsitem.headline: Four killed in Colombian air crash.

text.p: Four people were killed on Friday when their charter plane crashed about 12 minutes after takeoff from Colombia's western city of Pereira, authorities said.

The Citation-Cessna aircraft, en route from Pereira to the northwest citry of Medellin, was carrying two passengers and two crew members when it hit a mountain in a rural area of the coffee-growing province of Caldas, a statement from Colombia's Civil Aviation Authority said.
It said the plane's pilot reported technical problems shortly before the crash, the cause of which was under investigation.
Apart from pilot Jaime Cardona the identities of the victims were not known.
